names: DsMenuBar 剩余合同 opens on click, focuses the first enabled item and executes real selections
DsMenuBar 剩余合同 arrow keys move between triggers without opening from a closed bar, ArrowDown opens
DsMenuBar 剩余合同 sections, checkbox items, href navigation and disabled entries keep their contracts
DsToolbar 剩余合同 executes real commands and renders pressed, busy, disabled and grouped chrome
handleMenuCharacterSearch 剩余合同 matches single unmodified characters case-insensitively by label prefix
handleMenuCharacterSearch 剩余合同 ignores multi-character keys and modifier chords
标题读档入口:标题菜单选读档后从真实存档完成开局
标题入口视频:选中入口先播 intro 视频再进世界
启动视频序列:无 skip-startup 时按 manifest 角色顺序播完两段再进标题菜单
播放中快速读档:中止在途视频并按存档游标重放,奖励只结算一次
资源解析中取消:视频 urlFor 返回后不再创建视频层,重放才首次开播
战败读最近档:多槽按 savedAt 恢复最新,战败流程不再重开
战败无档重开:读档入口在零存档下安静收口,世界不被任何槽替换
场景 BGM 缺席曲臂:显式 null 停曲并落 world.audio.currentMusic=null,缺省场景延续不写键
